description.label: Description
description.value:
Minor Mental Mutation

You've developed an irrational fear towards some specific type of creature, environment or experience. When faced with the object of your fright, it's causing you @Terror[1]. Roll on the @Table[fright] Table to determine the source of your fear, or consult the GM. If the result is a category, then pick something specific. For additional levels you may choose to increase the level of Terror for the same source, or add an additional source. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.jrFIFLhyOYwcyMUl]{Flee!} Talent, but it only applies when fleeing from the source of your fright.
